ValidationRule.description: When the user selects the 'Referral for an existing customer?' field, the 'Existing Customer' field appears and should be restricted to only customers with the source system 'CAP'.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, $Profile.Name = 'ANZ CCRM Standard User', NOT(ISBLANK(FinServ__RelatedAccount__c)), FinServ__RelatedAccount__r.Source_System_Name__c <> 'CAP-CIS', OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCRM_Lead', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Referral' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Unsupported customer profile selected. Please choose a valid CAP customer profile to proceed.
